summary: Former fire lookout site on the Appalachian Trail, Union County GA; on 1935 and 1946 USGS maps; a 1972 USGS party called it destroyed; footing remains.

facts.status_note: Willhite lists it as a former lookout; a 1972 USGS party called the tower destroyed and set a benchmark in its footing

access.note: Reached by a 0.3-mile alternate trail from the Appalachian Trail; level inferred from trail access, no land-manager statement found

visit.trail_note: 0.3-mile alternate trail with 500 feet of gain from the Appalachian Trail; no tower stands to climb

notes_for_editor: Identity link rests on name and county: tnlandforms GA160 'hawk mtn' (Union) and Willhite's Hawk Mountain Lookout Site (Union, on the Appalachian Trail). Willhite gives no coordinates, so location is not confirmed. Elevation conflict: 3,560 ft (Willhite) vs 3,576 ft (tnlandforms); brief elevation_m 1090 matches tnlandforms. tnlandforms prints no elevation unit, so 'feet' is inferred from the match with Willhite's feet figure and the brief's metric value. Access level 'public' is inferred from the AT alternate trail, not from a land manager. Willhite's page is undated, so the story makes no 'today' claim from it. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Georgia lists (checked 2026-10-21). Brief status and access 'unknown' are superseded by 'former lookout' per Willhite. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the 'only remnant' inference was removed, and the 1935 sentence no longer implies when the old trail ran over the summit.
